tweet.text:
Speculative decoding turns an H200's Llama 3.3 70B inference cost from $0.23 per million output tokens into $0.06.

Standard: ~1,700 tok/s. Eagle-3: ~6,200 tok/s, a 3.6x jump over standard decoding on the same GPU.

The draft head training the guesses is small: 1-3B params, 2-3GB VRAM. Full numbers
